description_expanded: OverviewHot TubLarge Porches - Private Beach - Community Pool-3 bikes-`Magnolia Cottage`The Space Magnolia Cottage – Cozy Coastal Retreat Near the Beach! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Complimentary Wi-Fi – Stay connected while you relax Quiet, Family-Friendly Neighborhood – Perfect for a peaceful getaway Quick Walk or Bike Ride to the Beach! – Enjoy t & charming beach towns Spacious Outdoor Porches – Ideal for morning coffee & evening wine Fully Equipped Kitchen – Modern appliances for easy meals & snacks Driveway Parking for 2 Vehicles – Hassle-free convenience Short Bike Ride to The Big Chill – Dining, shopping & live entertainment Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a stress-free stayWelcome to 8 WisteriaEscape to coastal bliss at our charming 3-bedroom vacation rental nestled within the picturesque Magnolia Cottages by the Sea neighborhood. Located just a short stroll from the pristine shores of the Gulf Coast, this enchanting retreat offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm.Step inside and be greeted by a thoughtfully designed interior that exudes warmth and tranquility. The spacious living area beckons you to unwind and relax, while the fully equipped kitchen invites culinary adventures with its modern amenities and stylish finishes.Retreat to one of three cozy bedrooms, each meticulously appointed to ensure a restful night's sleep. With comfortable bedding and ample space, you'll wake up refreshed and ready to embrace another day in paradise.One of the highlights of our vacation rental is the inviting porches, where you can savor your morning coffee or unwind with a glass of wine in the evening breeze. Let the sounds of nature and the gentle rustle of palm trees soothe your soul as you bask in the coastal ambiance.As a guest of our property, you'll have access to three complimentary bikes, perfect for exploring the idyllic surroundings and scenic pathways of the Magnolia Cottages by the Sea neighborhood. And when it's time to hit the beach, you'll be delighted to discover that the shimmering Gulf waters are just a leisurely stroll away.Whether you're seeking relaxation, adventure, or a bit of both, our vacation rental promises an unforgettable coastal getaway. Book your stay today and experience the charm of Magnolia Cottages by the Sea for yourself.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS :Master Bedroom : King sized bed, private en suite bathroomGuest Bedroom : King sized bed, private en suite bathroomBunk Room : Two sets of twin over full bunk beds, private en suite bathroomHall bunk bedAREA ATTRACTIONS:Welcome to the Magnolia Cottages by the Sea! These beautiful properties have been designed by award winning architects and make up one of the most perfect beach cottage communities in the area. The community offers a pool, a bocce court, a horseshoe pit and a private boardwalk to the beach. If you will be using a golf cart for the week, no worries as the community offers private golf cart parking along the beach. Magnolia Cottages is the perfect location for your next family vacation, there is truly something for everyone down here!Show less
